description: Create a persistent sticky note. Call this when a durable fact emerges (a decision, blocker, preference, context, or todo) that future sessions should retain.

category.description: decision | blocker | preference | context | todo (sets the TTL).

importance.description: P1 critical, P2 normal, P3 minor.

project_path.description: Absolute project root this note belongs to. Omit/null for a global note.

name: stickies_write
title: Write a sticky
